Package com.psd.entities

Class Conversation

java.lang.Object
com.psd.entities.Conversation
public class Conversation extends Object
The Conversation class represents a conversation between two users in a peer-to-peer messaging application. It maintains the list of messages exchanged between the two users, as well as details about the participants and the start time of the conversation.

Main functionalities include:

  • Adding messages to the conversation
  • Retrieving the list of messages
  • Checking if a user is a participant in the conversation
